changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'queue' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Search') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [queue].[Search]( [ID] [bigint] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [Class] [int] NOT NULL, [AssetTypeUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [Status] [int] NOT NULL, [Active] [bit] default(1) not null, [TargetCount] [int] default (0) not null, [Message] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [Start] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_Search_start] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NOT NULL, [LastUpdate] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_search_lastupdate] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NOT NULL ) END
